title: refactor(objectql): type the six #4918 erasure-pinned ObjectQL methods and move their bodies out of engine.ts with the codemod's fourth pass
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXX2qjqm2uXbJA8Jcv
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgErpL5pVngyYYPX5sGx2GhS)_
Fixes #30055

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`engine.ts` 里被 #4918 擦除钉住的六个 `ObjectQL` 方法，先把查询选项补上类型（`engine.ts` 的擦除点 6 → 0，退出 erasure baseline），再用 codemod 新加的第四遍 `--members` 把方法体搬进三个已有的 facet 模块。`engine.ts` 11,771 → 11,316 行。PIN 表和 facade 例外表各退六行，`referenceExists` 的 read-invention 台账行跟着改指向。
- 为什么改：维护者在 #30012 上说「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」「合并之后再继续」。第一遍 codemod 只能在未拆分的文件上跑，所以加了第四遍，它在已拆分的文件上按第一遍的规则搬指定方法。
- 风险与回滚：行为不变。四处直接删掉 `as any`，另外两处保留具名断言（见 Acceptance notes）。搬移由撤销证明逐字节还原 base；`.d.ts` 声明不变，只少了随方法体搬走的私有 docblock；objectql 测试 base 550 文件 / 10,979 = head。回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：① `engine.ts` 里六个擦除点的补类型提交 `c358b417`、`162cb326`；② `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 新的第四遍一节（`MEMBERS_CARD`）；③ `engine-references-and-master-detail.ts` 新增的四个成员。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members --verify --base baf1a536^`，应看到 `6 moved method(s)` 和 `does rebuild the base engine.ts and its modules byte-for-byte`，退出 0。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **The six #4918 sites are typed** (commits `c358b417`, `162cb326`, no behaviour change). `referenceExists`, `resolveMasterDetailParent`, `resolveMasterDetailParents` and `probeReferencingRows` drop the `as any` outright: their literals (`where` / `fields` / `context`) already satisfy `EngineQueryOptions`, so `tsc` now checks them. Two sites keep a named assertion instead of an erasure:
   - `seedAutonumber`: the keyset walk's page query types its `where` as `unknown` (it is this scan's filter AND-ed with the seek predicate), so the spread names that one slot as `EngineQueryOptions['where']` (an `Omit` of `where` from `KeysetPageQuery`, intersected with that slot). The runtime object is the same spread.
   - `inspectDanglingReferences`: the published `DanglingReferenceAuditPort.find` spells its options as a string-keyed record of unknowns, so the hand-over is `opts as EngineQueryOptions`. Changing the port would change the public `.d.ts`, which this card rules out.
   The rule's sites in `engine.ts` go from 6 to 0, so `engine.ts` leaves `scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json` and the lint rule now covers it like any other file.
2. **The codemod gains a fourth pass, `--members`** (`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`). The first pass refuses an `engine.ts` that already carries its stubs, and `main` has been split since #29986, so "re-run the codemod" needs a pass that works on the split file. `--members A,B` moves the named methods exactly as the first pass would: same stay rules (any reason refuses), same stub, same facet member, same docblock rule, into the facet module of the method's section that the first pass wrote, in class order. That module's header list, host interface and import lines grow by what the moved bodies read, and so do the class's statics route and that facet's host factory. The pass never starts a facet, reroutes a module or widens a generated export list; each of those refuses with exit 2. `--members --verify --base REF` undoes the moves from the head alone and requires the base `engine.ts` and modules byte for byte, every other generated module unchanged, and each moved member equal to its base method's text. Pass 1's renderers are shared, not copied: five pure helpers were extracted from it (`classStaticsOf`, `specifierImportLines`, `moduleHeaderLines`, `facetMethodText`, `hostInstallLines`), and its 105 self-test cases still pass unchanged.
3. **The six bodies move** (commit `baf1a536`, generated, not hand-edited): `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members seedAutonumber,referenceExists,resolveMasterDetailParent,resolveMasterDetailParents,inspectDanglingReferences,probeReferencingRows --write`.
   - `engine-defaults-and-autonumbers.ts` takes `seedAutonumber`; `engine-references-and-master-detail.ts` takes `referenceExists`, `resolveMasterDetailParent`, `resolveMasterDetailParents` and `inspectDanglingReferences`; `engine-cascade-planning.ts` takes `probeReferencingRows`.
   - The private five move with their docblocks; `inspectDanglingReferences` is public, so its docblock stays on the class and the module carries the placeholder.
   - `ObjectQLStatics` gains `referenceCheckContext`. The references facet's host gains `find`, `findOne`, `materializeParentHeader`, `resolveEnginePosture`. Nine import bindings only the moved bodies read leave `engine.ts`.
4. **The pin and allow-list rows retire**: the six `PATH_READER_PINS` rows (the table is now empty), the six #30019 no-body exceptions in `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`, and the `referenceExists` entry in `scripts/durability-read-invention.baseline.json` now names `engine-references-and-master-detail.ts`, where its body lives.

Size: 9 files, +1,479 / −609 = 2,088 changed lines (under 3,000).

## Tests

- `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test`: 124 cases in 9 batteries pass. The new battery `named methods onto the split class (fourth pass)` has 18 cases: the first pass keeps two pinned fixture methods; the fourth pass moves both into the right module in class order; the proof holds and two runs write identical trees; the stub is the first pass's with `async` dropped; a private docblock moves and a protected one stays; the header, host interface and factory, statics route and imports each grow by exactly what the bodies read; engine.ts prunes what only the bodies read and keeps a type a stub's signature still names; unknown, already-moved, stay-rule and still-pinned names refuse; and the proof fails on an edited body character, a host member nothing reads, an unread import, a stub that kept `async`, an unrelated edit in `engine.ts` or another module, and a head that moved nothing.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: base (`f7afab86` sources) 550 files / 10,979 tests passed; head 550 / 10,979 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0 (tsc and `check:test-typecheck`).

## Acceptance notes

- Two named assertions stay (the two sites in What changes 1). They name the contract the value is read under, which is what the #4918 rule asks for when the value crosses a boundary typed looser than the engine. Neither is counted by the rule.
- `homeAmountReadsFor` (added by hand in #30280) sits in `engine-references-and-master-detail.ts` out of class order and missing from the module header's list. The fourth pass reads the header's own list and adds its names to it, leaving that drift as it stands. Not a defect; noted for whoever next regenerates the module.
- `.d.ts`: the private methods' docblocks leave the bundled `.d.ts` with their bodies (211 lines in each of `util-HASH.d.ts` and `util-HASH.d.mts`). Ruling 6624345766 item 1 says a private docblock moves with its body. This is the same reading #30341 / #30415 gave.

## Verification

<details><summary>Undo proof on the real tree</summary>

`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members --verify --base baf1a536^` exit 0:

```text
undo proof: 6 moved method(s) (seedAutonumber, referenceExists, resolveMasterDetailParent, resolveMasterDetailParents, inspectDanglingReferences, probeReferencingRows); engine.ts 11776 -> 11316 lines; undoing the moves does rebuild the base engine.ts and its modules byte-for-byte once the 9 import binding(s) only moved bodies read are pruned from the base (AUTONUMBER_SEED_PAGE_SIZE, AuditableObject, KeysetPageQuery, declaredMultiValued, isMissingTableError, isStoredMetadataBodyObject, keysetWalk, materializeDeclaredFields, readStoredAutonumberCounter)
```

Against `main` (`f7afab86`) the same command refuses all six (`the facet member is not its base method's text`), because the typing commits changed those bodies. The move is proved against the commit just before it; the typing is the reviewed diff.
</details>

<details><summary>Declarations, base vs head</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql build` at `f7afab86` sources and at head. The chunk name hash (`util-HASH`) was normalised. `core.d.ts`, `core.d.mts`, `index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts` are byte-identical once the hash is normalised. The two `util-HASH` files differ by 422 lines, every one a docblock line. With docblocks stripped, all six declaration files are byte-identical.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

Re-erasing one moved site (`as any` back on `referenceExists`'s options in `engine-references-and-master-detail.ts`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` exits 1 with `engine-references-and-master-detail.ts: NEW engine query-options erasure (1 site(s))`. Restored to HEAD; the hash matches and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 74 families, 80 commands. Among them are the fourth-pass verify, the codemod self-test, eslint on the touched files, and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`. All 80 recorded `exit 0`, and `--ran` reconciles: `74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.

Two first ran `exit 3` (prerequisite, not measured) and were rerun green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed `pnpm build` (119 of 119 tasks; then 116 entry points across 71 packages load).

Named here because the card asks: `check-facade-delegation-only` passes with `5 facade class(es) in 3 file(s) hold delegations only, 62 named exception(s)` (six fewer); `check:query-options-erasure` passes with `30 unswept … 13 file(s), none new`; `check:liveness` passes.
</details>
